claim: Bonnezeaux and Coteaux du Layon surround it.
because: Quarts de Chaume Grand Cru lies within part of a single commune, Rochefort-sur-Loire, on the right bank of the Layon. It is surrounded by Coteaux du Layon, including the Chaume premier cru. Bonnezeaux is a separate enclave at Thouarcé, about 13 km to the southeast, and does not border it.
fix: Minimum 298 g/L must weight; Coteaux du Layon (with its Chaume premier cru) surrounds it, and Bonnezeaux lies about 13 km upstream at Thouarcé.
